description: This file contains the implementation of the Silo class for Orleans Runtime, managing silo lifecycle, initialization, and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: Silo
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and operations of an Orleans silo, including startup, shutdown, and resource management.

classes.name: LifecycleSchedulingSystemTarget
classes.description: A system target used for scheduling silo lifecycle-related tasks.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the silo asynchronously, initializing lifecycle targets and services.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the silo, ensuring ongoing operations are finished or halted appropriately.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of resources held by the silo.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of resources held by the silo.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers lifecycle participants for silo startup and shutdown phases.
